title: Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
abstract: arXiv:2611.30895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same ela

translated_title: 看到再说：主动任务助手应等待证据，而非依赖时钟
translated_abstract: 能够引导人们完成物理任务的主动式助手，必须每隔几秒就判断某一步骤是否已完成、是否发生了错误。我们发现，该任务的两个现有基准在很大程度上奖励的是“知道何时”而非“看到什么”：一个从不观看视频、仅在25秒时发出警报并在30秒时确认每一步的计时器，在Ego-MC-Bench上达到了0.373的错误F1分数，高于所有已发表的结果（最高仅为0.27）。我们将这一现象形式化为“视频盲区前沿”——即策略仅凭经过时间、指令和训练统计数据所能达到的完成准确率与错误F1之间的最佳权衡：Ego-MC-Bench上所有已发表的分步结果均落在该前沿之内，我们在QICD上运行的十二个零样本模型也是如此。为了突破这一前沿，我们提出了证据对比训练（ECT）：在基准自身的问题上进行微调，并将其正样本与来自同一录像、同一经过时间的负样本配对。
tldr: 论文揭示现有主动任务助手基准主要被基于时间的启发式策略“破解”，提出“视频盲区前沿”概念量化这一局限，并引入证据对比训练（ECT）使助手基于真实的视觉证据而非时钟等待来做出判断。
en_tdlr: The paper exposes that existing benchmarks for proactive task assistants are largely solved by time-based heuristics—formalized as a "video-blind frontier"—and introduces Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT) to push models beyond it by grounding decisions in visual evidence rather than elapsed time.
